body:
Hi @geoand, thanks for checking this out. 

Looking through the change you linked to in your last comment (#29560), the associated bug report (#16103) and the  reproducer ( [reproducer](https://github.com/flupec/quarkus-issue-rreproducer) ) and seeing that the fix in #29560 was applied to the LocalEventBusCodec which ships with Quarkus, I just went and took a look at it.

I seem to understand (correct me if I am wrong) that it's not enough for the name of the codec to be unique. 
Apparently the name of the _instance_ of the codec must also be unique.
Is that correct? Internally, the codec, I assume, is instantiated twice?

So a workaround for my Codec would be to just make the name unique at the instance level, correct?

> So a workaround for my Codec would be to just make the name unique at the instance level, correct?

Correct

> Should the feature added in https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/pull/29560 be limited to that Codec?

Yes.

issue.title: Limit subclass codec registration to known working codecs
